brief:
The American Arab University in Ramallah held a graduation ceremony for its 23rd cohort, the Ma'an news agency reported. The event brought together graduating students and their families on the university's Ramallah campus to mark the academic milestone. The ceremony compressed years of coursework, study, and effort into moments of achievement as students completed their degrees and prepared to begin the next phase of their lives.

The graduation marked a significant transition for the cohort, who will now move beyond their time at the institution to pursue careers and further opportunities in their respective fields.
title: American Arab University graduates 23rd cohort in Ramallah ceremony
